description: Create apps/web: Vite + React 18 PWA with Tailwind CSS, design tokens as CSS variables, i18next (en/th), React Router, PWA manifest, minimal service worker, and three routes (/, /home, /health-check). Includes one passing Vitest test.
steps: Create apps/web/ directory and initialize with `pnpm create vite@latest . --template react-ts` inside apps/web/

Update apps/web/package.json: name @orbit/web, add dependencies: react-router-dom, i18next, react-i18next, tailwindcss, autoprefixer, postcss, @vitejs/plugin-react, vite-plugin-pwa (or @vite-pwa/plugin), vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom; add workspace dependency: @orbit/shared: workspace:*
Create apps/web/tsconfig.json extending ../../packages/config/tsconfig.base.json with jsx: react-jsx, lib: [DOM, DOM.Iterable, ESNext]
Create apps/web/tailwind.config.js with content: ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}'], theme extending design tokens as Tailwind utilities
Create apps/web/postcss.config.js with tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins

Create apps/web/vite.config.ts with @vitejs/plugin-react and vite-plugin-pwa configured; PWA manifest: { name: 'ORBIT', short_name: 'ORBIT', theme_color: '#7c6af7', icons: [192x192, 512x512 placeholders] }; env vars: VITE_API_BASE_URL, VITE_WS_URL, VITE_APP_NAME
Create apps/web/.env.example with VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000, VITE_WS_URL=ws://localhost:4000, VITE_APP_NAME=ORBIT

Create apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css with exact CSS variables from spec (backgrounds, ink, brand colors for Navi/Raya, semantic colors, typography, spacing, radius); include @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) overrides
Update apps/web/src/index.css to @import './styles/tokens.css' and apply base Tailwind styles with design tokens
Create apps/web/src/i18n/locales/en.json with keys: app.name, app.tagline, splash.loading, nav.home
Create apps/web/src/i18n/locales/th.json with Thai translations and _meta.reviewed: false
Create apps/web/src/i18n/config.ts initializing i18next with en/th resources, fallbackLng: 'en', detection from localStorage and navigator
Create apps/web/src/App.tsx with React Router setup: BrowserRouter with routes for /, /home, /health-check
Create apps/web/src/pages/Splash.tsx displaying app.name and app.tagline from i18n, centered on screen with design tokens
Create apps/web/src/pages/Home.tsx placeholder with nav.home heading
Create apps/web/src/pages/HealthCheck.tsx calling GET /health from API and displaying status
Update apps/web/src/main.tsx to import i18n config, initialize i18n, render App with Suspense fallback
Create apps/web/vitest.config.ts with jsdom environment and test glob patterns
Create apps/web/src/__tests__/App.test.tsx verifying Splash page renders with correct tagline
Create apps/web/public/icons/ directory with placeholder 192x192.png and 512x512.png icons (can be simple colored squares for now)
Run `pnpm --filter @orbit/web build` to verify Vite build succeeds
Run `pnpm --filter @orbit/web test` to verify tests pass
acceptance_criteria: Vite dev server starts successfully on localhost:5173
Splash page (/) displays 'ORBIT' and 'Two worlds. One orbit.' in English
Language can be switched to Thai and displays correct translations
Tailwind CSS applies design tokens correctly (dark theme by default)
PWA manifest.json is generated with correct theme_color and icons
All three routes render without errors
At least one Vitest test passes
Build produces dist/ directory with optimized assets
verification: Run `pnpm --filter @orbit/web dev` and manually visit http://localhost:5173 - Splash page renders
Open DevTools and verify no console errors
Check Application > Manifest in DevTools - manifest.json is present with correct values
Check apps/web/dist/ contains index.html, assets/, manifest.json
